old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a car's radiator being cleaned. The radiator is visibly dirty, covered in grime and debris. A yellow microfiber cloth is used to wipe the surface, moving across the metal fins. Water flows down the radiator fins, indicating spraying or rinsing. The cloth interacts with the dirty surface, showing the removal of dirt.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a car's radiator being cleaned. The radiator is visibly dirty, covered in grime and debris. A yellow sponge is used to scrub the surface, moving back and forth across the metal fins. Water sprays onto the radiator, washing away the dirt and foam. The camera remains steady throughout, focusing on the cleaning process. The sponge moves methodically, ensuring thorough cleaning of the radiator. The water continues to spray, rinsing off the loosened grime. The video emphasizes the effectiveness of the cleaning process, showing the gradual removal of dirt and the restoration of the radiator's cleanliness.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a wire mesh screen covered with droplets and damp patches. Fine vertical wires span the left and center. A bright yellow-green fuzzy textile sits along the right edge, overlapping a pale frame bar. Beyond the bar lies a dark object showing curved tan segments. The viewpoint drifts slowly, changing the wet pattern's scale so the wires look finer toward the left. As this reframing continues, the yellow textile slides toward the bottom-right corner, covering less of the right side. More of the dark object emerges, and the bar edges rightward with handheld wobble. The droplet patches remain mostly fixed, with no visible wiping or dripping.
